items.title: Fatigue, high altitude or voodoo: Team management perplexed over Nahid Rana's injury
items.summary: The Bangladesh Cricket Board (BCB) and its medical department remain perplexed about how Nahid Rana sustained his injury during the Tigers' tour of Zimbabwe earlier this month, despite his workload being carefully managed.

items.title: Rana, Taskin to depart for Perth tonight

items.title: Bashar regrets Rana's absence from Australia tour despite being 'extra cautious'

items.title: Bangladesh excited for next tours as Joty sets lofty goal
